# TechTrinity

> TechTrinity designs and builds custom software for wholesale and distribution businesses — tools for stock, orders, and reporting, connected to the systems a team already uses, with practical AI automation where it helps. Engagements can start with one workflow and expand as the business needs.

TechTrinity is for owners and operations leaders at wholesale and distribution businesses with manual work between orders, inventory, reporting, and existing software. It also builds focused first versions of B2B products (MVPs) and business websites connected to an enquiry process.

TechTrinity is not a SaaS subscription product or a template-based ERP vendor. It recommends an existing product when one fits the workflow. Where custom software is justified, it maps the workflow, agrees the scope, and builds software that is designed for daily use and can be maintained and improved.

Primary technology stack: React, Next.js, Node.js, Django, and PostgreSQL on modern cloud infrastructure. TechTrinity does not offer Laravel or PHP development.

Founder: Usama Nadeem (Usama Bin Nadeem), Founder & CEO, based in Lahore, Pakistan. He built EasyAccounts, his own ERP product, for his family's wholesale business, and has engineering experience at Canonical, the company behind Ubuntu.

Core positioning:

* Custom software for wholesale and distribution operations: stock, orders, reporting, and integrations
* Start with one valuable workflow; expand in agreed phases when justified
* Practical AI automation with explicit boundaries and human review where needed
* Clear scope, agreed milestones, and changes approved before additional work begins
* Direct access to the people responsible for the project
* Free introductory call; a paid workflow assessment only when further discovery is needed
* Two weeks of launch support included; ongoing maintenance available separately under an agreement

## Services

* [Workflow Assessment](https://www.techtrinity.ai/services/workflow-assessment): Paid, separately scoped discovery for a costly workflow — process map, dependencies, build/configure/buy recommendation, and implementation options.
* [Defined Workflow Build](https://www.techtrinity.ai/services/build-only): Focused build for one defined operational workflow once the scope is sufficiently understood.
* [Larger Operations Build](https://www.techtrinity.ai/services/product-sprint): Larger operations systems delivered in agreed phases.
* [Ongoing Support & Improvements](https://www.techtrinity.ai/services/growth-retainer): Ongoing maintenance and improvement of live systems under an agreement.
* [Existing System Audit](https://www.techtrinity.ai/services/technical-audit): Technical review of an existing codebase — what to fix, replace, or leave alone.
* [AI Workflow Automation](https://www.techtrinity.ai/services/ai-workflow-automation): Bounded AI automation for enquiries, documents, and routine information requests, with defined human approval.
* [MVP Development](https://www.techtrinity.ai/services/mvp-development): Focused first versions of B2B products.
* [Business Websites](https://www.techtrinity.ai/services/business-websites): Business websites connected to an enquiry process.

## Use Cases

* [Inventory Accuracy](https://www.techtrinity.ai/use-cases/inventory-accuracy): Stock movements, transfers, adjustments, product availability, audit trails, and location-level stock visibility.
* [Manual Reporting](https://www.techtrinity.ai/use-cases/manual-reporting): Dashboards and reports for stock, sales, purchases, margins, receivables, and branch performance.
* [Order Workflows](https://www.techtrinity.ai/use-cases/order-workflows): Order status pipelines for sales, warehouse, picking, dispatch, backorders, and internal handoffs.

## Case Studies

* [EasyAccounts ERP](https://www.techtrinity.ai/work/easyaccounts): The founder's own product — a production ERP built with React and Django for his family's wholesale textile business, live across 12+ branches and in production for 4 years. Handles purchasing, sales, inventory, financial reporting, cheque management, audit logs, and role-based access control with 189+ permissions.
* [Canonical Academy](https://www.techtrinity.ai/work/canonical-academy): Founder's engineering work, in-house at Canonical — certification platform work involving Go, Node.js, React, payment flows, exam scheduling, proctoring integration, and badge issuance. Not a TechTrinity client engagement.
* [Xenia](https://www.techtrinity.ai/work/xenia): Founder's engineering work as an employee of Xenia (not a TechTrinity client project) on a frontline operations platform — tasks, checklists, audits, reporting, and performance improvements for multi-location teams.
* [Hirecinch ATS](https://www.techtrinity.ai/work/hirecinch): Founder's engineering work as an employee of Hirecinch (not a TechTrinity client project) on an applicant tracking system built with React and Django — structured applications, a shared candidate pipeline, scorecards, and email workflows.

* Purchasing and replenishment workflows
* Branch transfer workflows
* Audit trails and accountability
* Custom ERP systems and spreadsheet replacement

* MVPs for B2B products
